# ParkRating

> ParkRating is a theme park review and scoring site run by two brothers who visit and rate parks across Europe and beyond.

## What we do

We visit theme parks and score them across 10 categories, each out of 10:
- Best Coaster
- Coaster Depth
- Water Rides
- Flat Rides & Dark Rides
- Park Appearance
- Food
- Snacks & Drinks
- Park Practicality
- Ride Operations
- Park Management

The overall score is the average of these 10 category scores. All scores reflect our most recent published visit to each park.

We also rate individual roller coasters on a 0–10 scale with written reviews covering elements like airtime, intensity, layout, and reridability.

## Key pages

- [Park rankings](https://parkrating.com/parks): all reviewed parks, sorted by overall score
- [Coaster ratings and rankings](https://parkrating.com/coasterLibrary): every rated roller coaster with its score
- [Manufacturer hall of fame](https://parkrating.com/manufacturers): makers ranked by Best Coaster awards and average score
- [About ParkRating](https://parkrating.com/about): who we are and how we score
- [All reviews in one Markdown file](https://parkrating.com/llms-full.txt): every park review and coaster review, with scores
- [Sitemap](https://parkrating.com/sitemap.xml): every indexable page

Individual park reviews live at https://parkrating.com/park/{slug} and individual coaster reviews at https://parkrating.com/coasters/{slug}; the full list of both is in the sitemap and in llms-full.txt.

## Optional

- [Europa-Park review](https://parkrating.com/park/europa-park): example of a park page with the 10 category scores and the written review
- [Coaster rankings](https://parkrating.com/coasterLibrary): example of the ItemList markup and per-coaster scores

## Data notes

- All scores are on a 0–10 scale
- A park appears in rankings only after at least one published visit
- Reviews reflect real visits by the site's authors
- Schema.org AggregateRating markup is present on all reviewed park pages
- Schema.org Review markup with full reviewBody text is present on all park pages, and on coaster pages that have a written review (not every rated coaster has one yet; those pages carry the rating and ride data only)
- Schema.org BreadcrumbList markup is present on park and coaster pages
- Schema.org ItemList markup is present on the park rankings page (/parks), the coaster ratings page (/coasterLibrary), and the manufacturers page (/manufacturers), listing each entry with name, URL, position, and a natural-language description including scores
